evidence.claim: The motif pair 'hidden_conspiracy' and 'loss_of_innocence' has a median ROI of 5.685 across 13 films.
evidence.sql_query:
SELECT motif_a, motif_b,
       countMerge(sample_count) AS n_roi,
       quantileMerge(0.5)(roi_median) AS roi_median,
       countMerge(interest_sample_count) AS n_interest,
       quantileMerge(0.5)(interest_pct_median) AS interest_median
FROM mv_motif_pair_stats
WHERE (motif_a = 'hidden_conspiracy' AND motif_b = 'loss_of_innocence')
   OR (motif_a = 'loss_of_innocence' AND motif_b = 'hidden_conspiracy')
GROUP BY motif_a, motif_b
HAVING n_roi >= 8

evidence.claim: Films featuring at least one of 'hidden_conspiracy' or 'loss_of_innocence' motifs and at least one of 'authority_figure' or 'caregiver' archetypes have a median ROI of 2.214 across 41 films.
evidence.sql_query:
SELECT count()                                    AS n_roi,
       quantile(0.5)(roi)                         AS roi_median,
       quantile(0.75)(roi)                        AS roi_p75,
       countIf(has_interest_signal)               AS n_interest,
       quantileIf(0.5)(interest_cohort_pct, has_interest_signal)
                                                  AS interest_median,
       arrayStringConcat(arraySlice(groupArray(title), 1, 5), ', ') AS comparable_titles
FROM films
WHERE roi IS NOT NULL
  AND (has(motif_tags, 'hidden_conspiracy') OR has(motif_tags, 'loss_of_innocence'))
  AND (has(character_archetypes, 'authority_figure') OR has(character_archetypes, 'caregiver'))

caveats: Analogues were drawn from the mid budget band. The proposal has no budget of its own; this band was assumed for the comparison.
Analogues span 1990-2014 with no era filter. The dataset ends at 2014 because the plot corpus does, not because later films were excluded.
Attention reflects sustained Wikipedia lookups from 2015 onward, measured 1-25 years after release. It is not opening-weekend attention.
The dataset includes films released between 1990 and 2014.
Interest metrics reflect sustained attention years after release, not initial buzz or opening performance.
Budget ranges for film-level analogues are specific to the filtered sets.
